decisions.reason: With quantified government adoption through UK e-Borders and over 30 APIS connections, the product exceeds aspiration levels and anchors the firm's aviation data business, so problemistic search is not triggered.

The travel health requirements API reports no results, and post-pandemic demand is fading, but it still has its own page in 2024, and the growing firm's slack lets it carry a low-cost digital add-on that fits its passenger data suite.

The document verification platform sits close to the core offer and supports airline compliance needs, and with no shortfall signalled against aspirations and slack available in an expanding firm, it is retained.
